title: Aryabhatiya
author: Aryabhata (499 CE)
intro: Aryabhata wrote the Aryabhatiya in 499 CE, at the age of 23, in just 121 verses. These three verses give his value of π, his idea that the Earth turns while the stars stand still, and his explanation of why the Moon and planets shine.
note: The Aryabhatiya is written in the Arya meter, which counts matras (light = 1, heavy = 2) instead of syllables. Each verse is shown here as two half-verses of 30 and 27 matras; the meter scanner counts them for you.
